\begin{example} \end{example}[circle segments]

Source: petersen:page-0195 ↗ lem:pet-ch5-distance-function-segments 1. ch5:5.3.4For $M=S^1$, $U=S^1-\{ (1,0)\} $, the distance function $r(\theta )=\theta $, $\theta \in (0,2\pi )$, shows any $c(\theta )=(\cos \theta ,\sin \theta )$, $\theta \in I\subset (0,2\pi )$, is a segment in $U$; but if the length of $I$ exceeds $\pi $, $c$ is not a segment in $S^1$. \end{example}
